product.name: Vayu Sense
product.description: A sensor technology that detects small and hard-to-see objects, including glass surfaces, by analyzing properties of received light beyond intensity and depth.

product.name: VayuSim
product.description: A simulation environment built on Unreal Engine 5 for generating diverse road and urban scenarios to train and test autonomous mobility models.

product.name: Vayu Drive
product.description: An autonomous driving system powered by Vayu’s AI robotics foundation model for on-road delivery robots.
